about: Ask about this on an analysis that needs a decision (doctor issue ONE_CONDITION).
question: Why is there no volcano plot?

model.content:
All 4 samples were read as DMSO, so there is nothing to compare and no volcano plot can be made [issue:ONE_CONDITION] [job:1].

Give each sample its condition in the window (Guess from names fills in a suggestion) and Run analysis [help:issue.ONE_CONDITION].
